WHY FIRSTRUNG?

Everyone needs a first rung.

FirstRung started with a personal frustration: graduating without an internship and trying to find a way into a career.

When entry-level hiring feels geared toward returning interns, it can be hard to see where you fit. That was the experience behind this project, especially in the search for a first job in tech.

Graduate development programs offer another route worth exploring: structured training, mentorship, and a chance to grow into the work. FirstRung brings those programs together so you can spend less time sorting through student internships and more time finding opportunities that fit.

A program isn’t a promise of an offer, and requirements still vary. The aim is simpler: make the next possible step easier to find.

Built by a new graduate, for other new graduates.
OUR EDITORIAL STANDARD

A program, not just a job title.

We include employer-described graduate programs with structured training, rotations, or a defined development cohort in the United States or Canada.

  • Full-time opportunities for graduates, including master’s graduates where explicitly eligible.
  • No internships requiring continued college enrollment, ordinary Level 1 jobs, or postings restricted to returning interns.
  • Employer-specific graduation windows apply. Being within three years of graduation does not guarantee eligibility.

Clear about what we know

“Open” requires a reviewed application posting. Program overview pages are labeled “Check availability.” Dates are never inferred from a previous year. Degree filters include only explicitly documented qualifications.

When applications close

Closed programs can be shown for 14 days after the recorded closing date, then disappear from results. When no deadline is published, an editor must confirm and record the closure. Listings are curated, not a live employer feed.

FirstRung is an independent directory. Applications happen on employers’ websites.
